reviews.title: Wayyyy too many ads!!
reviews.text:
Okay, so I understand why games have to include ads. I played two levels…ad! Two more levels..ad! Then again, Two more..ad! So I deleted it. Three full ads within six levels (which took only a few seconds each) is ridiculous. Wish I could give zero stars! 

Also, one of the levels was a cat scooting on the carpet leaving a trail of poo!! I’m all for crude humor but that’s just unnecessary!
